quota_rule: Hamilton proportional allocation from 28/28/16 to 12; equal fractional remainders break by larger source family then family name. Result: 5/5/2.
static_selection: Within each family, sort eligible eval cases by (operations,path), divide ranks into quota contiguous strata using boundaries floor(s*n/quota), and select the smallest SHA256(salt + newline + path + newline + raw_sha256) in each stratum. No reselection.
dynamic_selection: All 12 distinct published base streams, retaining original train/dev/holdout labels.
score: case-mean-v1: mean of 24 per-case scores; exactly one half of total weight per source group; first normalize each repetition against paired Naive then average repetitions and cases.
limitations: All12 dynamic contains prior training examples and previously evaluated holdouts; this is a regression benchmark, not a new blind generalization test.
Static and dynamic also differ in length, memory pressure, phase overlap, conditional skew, bandwidths and penalty; this is not a controlled causal ablation of cross-partition heat correlation.
The 50/50 group weight is a user-selected coverage policy, not an estimate of the hidden-test distribution.
Future training must not consume this suite as a training or label-generation source; existing exposure cannot be undone.
